name: u
meaning: U origin of the frame bitmap in its texture page (UiFrame_LoadSkin 0x53a0ae writes [this+8*i+0x18]; UiCursor_Draw 0x53a34e reads it)

name: v
meaning: V origin of the frame bitmap (0x53a0bc write, 0x53a362 read)

name: wMinus1
meaning: frame bitmap width - 1 (0x53a0ce write; UiCursor_SetSlide 0x538ef1 reads frames[0])

name: hMinus1
meaning: frame bitmap height - 1 (0x53a0e0 write; UiCursor_SetPos 0x538ecb reads frames[0])

name: texIndex
meaning: texture page of the frame bitmap (0x53a04c write as word [this+8*i+0x1e]; UiCursor_Draw 0x53a472 reads it)
